subject: general
question: Identify the Indian musician who is associated with any string instrument.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pandit Ravi Shankar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Pandit Ravi Shankar **was instrumental in introducing Indian classical music to international audiences.
 
• He composed music for several films, including collaborations with **George Harrison of The Beatles.**
 
• Shankar was a prolific educator, teaching music and promoting Indian classical traditions worldwide.
 
• He founded the **Ravi Shankar Institute for Music and Performing Arts in India**.
 
• His awards:-
 
 
• Grammy Award for Best
